""" This script finds the local ignition install path. And refreshed the provider selection dropdown. """
	from com.inductiveautomation.ignition.gateway import IgnitionGateway
	context = IgnitionGateway.get()
	projectParentFolder = str(context.systemManager.dataDir.absoluteFile).replace('\\','/').replace('data','')
	self.view.custom.installLocation = projectParentFolder
	self.view.custom.output += '\n\r Install Location: ' + projectParentFolder
	
	system.perspective.sendMessage('exchange.ExportBackup.refreshProviders')

"""
	This handler exports both tag instances (along with the corresponding UDTs) or only the UDT definitions and download directly through the perspective session.
	No file is saved to the local ignition server.
	This handler is not used in the current configuration of the view.
	"""	
	import datetime, time
	
	""" Initiate variables """
	theUser = system.perspective.getSessionInfo()
	output = self.view.custom.output
	theProviderName = self.view.custom.provider
	
	""" Error if no provider selected. """
	if theProviderName == "":
		output = output + '\n\r' + "Select a Provider to export tags"
		return
	
	""" Export json or instances and UDTs or only UDTs """
	if payload['udt']:
		fileName = theProviderName.strip('[]') + '__UDTs_' + datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + '.json'
		outputMsg = 'Exporting UDTs as ' + fileName
		output = output + '\n\r' + outputMsg
		system.util.audit('exportBackup','UDT Definitions',outputMsg)
		
		result = system.tag.exportTags(tagPaths = [theProviderName+'_types_'])
		system.perspective.download(fileName, result)
	else:
		fileName = theProviderName.strip('[]') + '__Instances_' + datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + '.json'   
		outputMsg = 'Exporting Instances as ' + fileName
		system.util.audit('exportBackup','Tag Instances',outputMsg)
		output = output + '\n\r' + outputMsg
		
		result = system.tag.exportTags(tagPaths = [theProviderName])
		system.perspective.download(fileName, result)

""" This handler queries the gateway and lists the providers available to take tag backups. It will update the dropdown menu at the top of the view. """
	svc = self.view.custom
	
	try:
		tags=system.tag.browse(filter={"tagType":"Provider"}).results
		
		providerList = []
		for result in tags:
			oList = {}
			
			provider = str(result['fullPath'])
			oList["value"] = provider
			oList["label"] = provider
			
			providerList.append(oList)
		
		sortedProvider = sorted(providerList,key=lambda k: k.get('value'))
		svc.providerSelection = sortedProvider
		svc.provider = ""

		svc.output += '\n\r' + "Providers Refreshed!"
	except:
		svc.output += '\n\r' + "Error: Cannot find any tag providers"
		system.util.audit('exportBackup','Provider Refrsh',"Error: Cannot find any tag providers")

"""
	This handler creates a zip file of the current project saves it to the local ignition server.
	The zip file is downloaded through the session and temporary files on the ignition server are deleted.
	"""	
	import os, datetime, zipfile, time, platform, sys
	
	""" Initiate variables """
	svc = self.view.custom
	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()
	theZipFile = projectName + '__archive_' + datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S') + '.zip'
	outputMsg = 'Creating file for \'' + projectName + '\' as ' + theZipFile + ' (timeout in 60 sec)'
	svc.output = svc.output + '\n\r' + outputMsg 
	system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Project',outputMsg)
	installLocation = svc.installLocation
	
	""" Determine gateway operating system to get download path """
	platformStr = str(platform.platform())
	if 'Linux' in platformStr:
		baseDir = installLocation
		dirPath = installLocation + 'data/projects/' + projectName
		
		with zipfile.ZipFile(theZipFile, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
		    lenDirPath = len(dirPath) + 1
		    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dirPath):
		        for fil in files:
		            filePath = os.path.join(root, fil)
		            zipf.write(filePath, filePath[lenDirPath:])
	elif 'Mac_OS' in platformStr:
		baseDir = installLocation
		dirPath = installLocation + 'data/projects/' + projectName
		
		with zipfile.ZipFile(theZipFile, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
		    lenDirPath = len(dirPath) + 1
		    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dirPath):
		        for fil in files:
		            filePath = os.path.join(root, fil)
		            zipf.write(filePath, filePath[lenDirPath:])
	elif 'Windows' in platformStr:
		baseDir = installLocation.replace('/','\\')
		dirPath = baseDir + 'data\\projects\\' + projectName
		
		with zipfile.ZipFile(baseDir+theZipFile, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
		    lenDirPath = len(dirPath) + 1
		    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dirPath):
		        for fil in files:
		            filePath = os.path.join(root, fil)
		            zipf.write(filePath, filePath[lenDirPath:])
	else:
		system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Project','OS Error')
		svc.output = svc.output + '\n\r' + 'OS Error'
		sys.exit(1)
	
	""" Wait until all files are created to not error the download function, then download the file and remove it from the local server. """
	timeoutCatch = 0
	checkDone = False
	while timeoutCatch<60 and not checkDone:
		if os.path.exists(baseDir+theZipFile):
			theFile = system.file.readFileAsBytes(baseDir+theZipFile)
			system.perspective.download(theZipFile, theFile)
			
			os.remove(baseDir+theZipFile)
			checkDone = True
		timeoutCatch += 1
		time.sleep(1)

"""
	This handler uses the shell command to create a gateway backup file and saves it to the local ignition server.
	The file is downloaded through the session and temporary files on the ignition server are deleted.
	"""	
	import datetime, time, os, platform, sys
	
	""" Initiate variables """
	svc = self.view.custom
	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()

	svc.output += '\n\r' + outputMsg
	system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Gateway',outputMsg)
	installLocation = svc.installLocation
	
	""" Determine gateway operating system to get download path """
	platformStr = str(platform.platform())
	if 'Linux' in platformStr:
		dirPath = installLocation+fileName
		system.util.execute([installLocation+'gwcmd.sh', '-b', fileName])
	elif 'Mac_OS' in platformStr:

	""" Wait until all files are created to not error the download function, then download the file and remove it from the local server. """
	timeoutCatch = 0
	checkDone = False
	while timeoutCatch<60 and not checkDone:
		if os.path.exists(dirPath):
			theFile = system.file.readFileAsBytes(dirPath)
			system.perspective.download(fileName, theFile)
			
			os.remove(dirPath)
			checkDone = True
		timeoutCatch += 1
		time.sleep(1)

"""
	This handler exports both tag instances (along with the corresponding UDTs), only the UDT definitions, the current project, and the gateway backup file to the local ignition server.
	It then compresses all four files into a zip folder to save download data and space.
	The zip file is downloaded through the session and temporary files on the ignition server are deleted.
	"""	
	import os, datetime, zipfile, time, platform, sys

	def getInstance(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp, theProviderName):
		""" This internal function creates an export of all Tag instances (along with the corresponding UDTs) and saves it to the local ignition server to compress. """
		if theProviderName == "":
			svc.output += '\n\r' + "Select a Provider to export tags"
			sys.exit(1)
		
		fileName = theProviderName.strip('[]') + '__Instances_' + timeStamp + '.json'
		outputMsg = 'Exporting Instances as ' + fileName
		system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','UDT Definitions',outputMsg)
		
		result = system.tag.exportTags(tagPaths = [theProviderName])
		system.file.writeFile(baseDir+fileName, result)
		
		return baseDir+fileName

	def getUDT(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp, theProviderName):
		""" This internal function creates an export of all UDT definitions and saves it to the local ignition server to compress. """
		if theProviderName == "":
			svc.output += '\n\r' + "Select a Provider to export tags"
			sys.exit(1)
		
		fileName = theProviderName.strip('[]') + '__UDTs_' + timeStamp + '.json'
		outputMsg = 'Exporting UDTs as ' + fileName
		system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','UDT Definitions',outputMsg)
		
		result = system.tag.exportTags(tagPaths = [theProviderName+'_types_'])
		system.file.writeFile(baseDir+fileName, result)
		
		return baseDir+fileName

	def getProject(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp):
		""" This internal function creates a zip file of the current project saves it to the local ignition server to compress. """
		fileName = projectName + '__export_' + timeStamp + '.zip'
		
		outputMsg = 'Creating file for \'' + projectName + '\' as ' + fileName + ' (timeout in 60 sec)'
		system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Project',outputMsg)
		
		if thePlatform == 'Linux' or thePlatform == 'Mac_OS':
			# Linux baseDir = '/usr/local/bin/ignition/'
			# Mac_OS baseDir = '/usr/local/ignition/'
			dirPath = baseDir + 'data/projects/' + projectName
			with zipfile.ZipFile(fileName, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
			    lenDirPath = len(dirPath) + 1
			    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dirPath):
			        for fil in files:
			            filePath = os.path.join(root, fil)
			            zipf.write(filePath, filePath[lenDirPath:])
		elif thePlatform == 'Windows':
			# baseDir = 'C:\\Program Files\\Inductive Automation\\Ignition\\data\\projects\\'
			dirPath = baseDir + 'data\\projects\\' + projectName
			
			with zipfile.ZipFile(baseDir+fileName, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as zipf:
			    lenDirPath = len(dirPath) + 1
			    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(dirPath):
			        for fil in files:
			            filePath = os.path.join(root, fil)
			            zipf.write(filePath, filePath[lenDirPath:])
		else:
			system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Project','OS Error')
			svc.output += '\n\r' + 'OS Error'
			sys.exit(1)
		
		return baseDir+fileName

	def getGWBackup(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp):
		""" This internal function uses the shell command to create a gateway backup and saves it to the local ignition server to compress. """
		fileName = projectName +'__GW_backup_' + timeStamp+'.gwbk'
	
		outputMsg = 'Creating file as ' + fileName + ' (timeout in 60 sec)'
		system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Gateway',outputMsg)
		
		if thePlatform == 'Linux':
			# Linux dirPath = '/usr/local/bin/ignition/'
			system.util.execute([baseDir+'gwcmd.sh', '-b', fileName])
		elif thePlatform == 'Mac_OS':
			# Mac_OS dirPath = '/usr/local/ignition/'
			system.util.execute([baseDir+'gwcmd.sh', '-b', fileName])
		elif thePlatform == 'Windows':
			# dirPath = 'C:\\'
			system.util.execute([baseDir+'gwcmd.bat', '-b', baseDir+fileName])
		else:
			system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup','Project','OS Error')
			svc.output += 'OS Error'
			sys.exit(1)
		
		return baseDir+fileName
	
	""" Initiate variables """
	svc = self.view.custom
	timeStamp = datetime.datetime.now().strftime('%Y%m%dT%H%M%S')
	theProviderName = svc.provider
	projectName = system.util.getProjectName()
	installLocation = svc.installLocation
	
	""" Determine gateway operating system to get download path """
	platformStr = str(platform.platform())
	if 'Linux' in platformStr:
		thePlatform = 'Linux'
		baseDir = installLocation
		platformSlash = "/"
	elif 'Mac_OS' in platformStr:
		thePlatform = 'Mac_OS'
		baseDir = installLocation
		platformSlash = "/"
	elif 'Windows' in platformStr:
		thePlatform = 'Windows'
		baseDir = installLocation.replace('/','\\')
		platformSlash = "\\"
	
	svc.output += '\n\r' + 'OS: '+thePlatform+' | Exporting All...'
	
	""" Run all above defined functions to get backup files """
	theFiles = [
		getInstance(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp, theProviderName),
		getUDT(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp, theProviderName),
		getProject(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp),
		getGWBackup(svc, thePlatform, baseDir, projectName, timeStamp)
		]
	
	if not self.view.params.isDocker:
		""" Add Wrapper Logs to file list """
		potentialFiles = [
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.1",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.2",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.3",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.4",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.5",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.6",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.7",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.8",
			baseDir + platformSlash + "logs" + platformSlash + "wrapper.log.9",
		]
		logFiles = []
		for eachFile in potentialFiles:
			if os.path.exists(eachFile):
				logFiles.append(eachFile)
		
		outputMsg = 'Exporting Wrapper Logs as wrapper.log*'
		svc.output += '\n\r' + outputMsg
		system.util.audit('exchange.exportBackup','Wrapper Logs',outputMsg)	
	
	""" Wait until all files are created to not error the compression """
	for eachFile in theFiles:
		timeoutCatch = 0
		checkDone = False
		while timeoutCatch<60 and not checkDone:
			if os.path.exists(eachFile):
				checkDone = True
			timeoutCatch += 1
			time.sleep(1)
		
#	time.sleep(6)

	""" Combine and compress all backup files created. """
	zipFileName = 'fullBackup__('+projectName+')_'+theProviderName+'_'+timeStamp+'.zip'
	with zipfile.ZipFile(baseDir+zipFileName, 'w', zipfile.ZIP_DEFLATED) as theZipFile:
		for fileName in theFiles:
			arcname = os.path.basename(fileName)  # Get only the file name
			theZipFile.write(fileName, arcname=arcname)
			svc.output += '\n\r' + str(fileName)
			time.sleep(0.25)
		if not self.view.params.isDocker:
			for fileName in logFiles:
				arcname = os.path.basename(fileName)  # Get only the file name
				theZipFile.write(fileName, arcname=arcname)
				svc.output += '\n\r' + str(fileName)
				time.sleep(0.25)
	# fullZipPath = os.path.abspath(zip_file)
	theZipFile.close()

	""" Read and download zip file through perspective session """
	system.util.audit('exchange.ExportBackup', 'All', 'All Exported as: '+zipFileName)
	theFile = system.file.readFileAsBytes(baseDir+zipFileName)
	system.perspective.download(zipFileName, theFile)

	""" Remove all temp files """
	for eachFile in theFiles:
		os.remove(eachFile)
	os.remove(baseDir+zipFileName)
	
	svc.output += '\n\r' + 'Finished!'
